findings.title: P2: Support freeze-gate reservations in development history intake
findings.body: The B570 dispatch requires consistent development reservations and runs the freeze counterexamples before the stall harness. Once the registered `development/freeze-r1` directory exists, this unconditional check requires its `WATCHDOG.jsonl`, but the supplied native-gate audit defines that run as four counterexample directories containing `EVENTS.jsonl`, not a watchdog run. Consequently, `stall_supervisor.py` fails in `development_budget()` before executing C1 or publishing `STALL_READY`, blocking the prescribed dispatch. Distinguish reservation types and validate freeze evidence using its actual schema, while retaining its attempt charge; do not require fabricated watchdog evidence or omission from accounting.

overall_explanation: The supplied dispatch sequence exposes a mismatch between development reservations and history intake that blocks the stall gate. Review covered the supplied patch statically; project code was not executed. Native Windows acceptance and unavailable legacy integration context remain unverified.
